commands.checks: Exhaustive census of every q_6 in {0,...,5}^6 summing to 6 and every centre letter with room for one more call. Expect 60 legal centres, all weight 3, of shape (1,6,6,0,0,0) up to permutation, and zero coordinates equal to 10. The nonnegative case split has the single solution (n0,n3,n5)=(3,2,0) at centre count 0. Each of the 60 vectors extends to a floor word. The one-step neighborhood has 480 legal realizable steps and 360 steps that move a 6 to a 5; every legal step keeps the centre coordinate equal to 1. Controls: a sum-6 near miss, the unique adjacent pair (6,7) and the absence of an adjacent pair on sum 28, one floor word with all seven sum-13 pairs legal, one floor word whose legal step moves a 6, the centre-letter increase exiting A, and the published word whose adjacent centre is illegal while pair (5,8) contains a 10.
Same census under optimized Python. Failures are explicit exceptions, not assertions.
